# Flow 7: setting up a vessel and managing the integrations on it.
#
# An integration is a folder in ~/.orbiter/integrations. `vessel init` copies the bundled folders
# there; there is no other install step. This flow is what a Captain does on a new machine: set
# up the vessel, load the profile line, look at an integration, and quarantine one that is behaving
# badly.

step set up the vessel, every way it can be asked for
exec orbiter init --yes
stdout 'Installed [0-9]+ integration\(s\)'
exec orbiter init vessel --yes
stdout 'Installed [0-9]+ integration\(s\)'
exec orbiter vessel init --yes
stdout 'Installed [0-9]+ integration\(s\)'
exists $HOME/.orbiter/integrations/git/manifest.toml

step an unknown init target is a mistake
! exec orbiter init badtarget
stderr 'unknown init target'

step the profile line: Orbiter finds the shell of the Captain through the shell integrations
# No environment is faked. The flow runs as a login in the host shell, and Orbiter asks the
# shell integrations which of them is this shell.
exec orbiter init shell
stdout 'orbiter'
exec orbiter shell init
stdout 'orbiter'

step look at an integration
exec orbiter vessel inspect git
stdout 'Integration: git'
stdout 'Status:      idle'
! stdout 'not installed'
exec orbiter vessel inspect unknown-brand
stdout 'Status:      missing'

step quarantine an integration that is misbehaving
exec orbiter quarantine git
stdout 'git is now quarantined'
exec orbiter survey git
stdout 'QUARANTINED'
stdout 'manual quarantine'
stdout 'orbiter unquarantine git'
exec orbiter vessel inspect git
stdout 'QUARANTINED'

step quarantining again changes nothing
exec orbiter quarantine git
stdout 'already quarantined'

step lift the quarantine
exec orbiter unquarantine git
stdout 'quarantine removed'
exec orbiter survey git
! stdout 'QUARANTINED'
exec orbiter unquarantine git
stdout 'not quarantined'

step the vessel command does the same through its own subcommand
exec orbiter quarantine golang
stdout 'golang is now quarantined'
exec orbiter vessel unquarantine golang
stdout 'quarantine removed'
exec orbiter survey golang
! stdout 'QUARANTINED'
